classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish stops from intervals, then find one interval and multiply by eight.

content.prompt: Nine bus stops are equally spaced along a road. The distance from the first to the third stop is 600 m. How far is it from the first stop to the last?

answer.short:
$2400\text{ m}$

There are eight equal gaps between nine stops.
answer.worked:
There are two equal gaps from the first stop to the third, and eight equal gaps from the first stop to the ninth.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Length of one gap}&=600\div2\text{ m}\\\text{Length of one gap}&=300\text{ m}\\\text{Total distance}&=8\times300\text{ m}\\\text{Total distance}&=2400\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
